in_sanskrit.name: शरिन्द
in_sanskrit.meaning: शरदोत्तम (Sharada Uttam) - Auspicious, excellent in autumn
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharinda is derived from the Sanskrit word शरद (Sharada) which means autumn. The suffix न्द (nda) is added to the name to denote excellence or auspiciousness. So, Sharinda means excellent or auspicious in autumn.

in_hindi.name: शरिन्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharinda is derived from the Sanskrit word शरद (Sharada) which means autumn. The suffix न्द (nda) is added to the name to denote excellence or auspiciousness. In Hindi, the name is pronounced as शरिन्द (Sharinda).

in_tamil.name: ஷரிந்தா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Sharinda is derived from the Sanskrit word शरद (Sharada) which means autumn. In Tamil, the name is pronounced as ஷரிந்தா (Sharinda). The meaning of the name is 'autumn beauty'. The suffix ன்தா (nda) in Tamil is added to denote feminine gender and also to convey the meaning of 'beauty'.

in_telugu.name: శరింద
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Sharinda is derived from the Sanskrit word शरद (Sharada) which means autumn. In Telugu, the name is pronounced as శరింద (Sharinda). The meaning of the name is 'auspicious, excellent in autumn'.

in_marathi.name: Sharinda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of love and beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharinda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharinda is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words 'shri', meaning 'goddess', and 'rinda', meaning 'love and beauty'.
